source: V0 mortgage experiment (KeristraCoreApplicationTests.test_experiment_Mortgage, 2025-10). Ground truth: Vlad's 8 original cases (category original-v0) + 37 cases added 2026-10-17 in Cowork (conflicts, boundaries, nulls, near-misses).
notes: The text leaves rule priority and the no-rule case to the reader. The same ground truth is shared with mortgage/disambiguated, so the two versions differ only in the rule text.
referenceDmn: Human reference written 2026-10-17 (knockouts first, then Fixed30, then ARM7/1, no default); passes 45/45 under a Python re-implementation of the FEEL subset used (pending confirmation with the Camunda-based StrictValidator). The earlier draft generated by claude-sonnet-5-5 (runs/mortgage-smoke-001, semantic hash 2b2d439296c9) is kept as reference.draft-sonnet.dmn: it passed the old 8 cases but fails 8/45 of the new ones, all of them knockout conflicts.
interpretation: Agreed with Vlad 2026-10-17: manual-review knockouts override every product rule; Fixed30 overrides ARM7/1; no default rule (expected null when nothing applies); a condition on a null value is not satisfied; 'below/above' are strict, 'or less/at least' are inclusive.
